purpose: Research and implementation inventory; never uploaded-file evidence or a guarantee of universal provider coverage.
coverage_warning: All four modalities are recorded for every provider, including gaps. A documented signal is not equivalent to a locally verified detector or complete product coverage. This is a curated provider-family inventory, not an exhaustive market census. Provider verification scores and watermark-family hits are distinct from trusted documentary declarations.

runtime.network_verification: disabled; this inventory performs no requests or customer uploads
runtime.verified_shortcut: Only trusted, valid, asset-bound, explicitly AI-declaring C2PA with no failures or unresolved remote reference.
runtime.local_document_c2pa: not integrated; plain text has no file credentials, and supported structured document metadata remains unverified
runtime.public_audioseal: isolated authored-signal evaluation completed; not admitted to serving or confidence
runtime.unchanged: Statistical calibrations, model weights, prepayment requirement and cloud deployment.
runtime.public_visual_wam: isolated authored image/video contract completed; not admitted to serving, AI confidence or early stopping
runtime.public_ltx_audio: 80-case native public audio pattern contract plus complete sample/codec audit; advisory research only, not serving

shortcut_rules: A negative, absent, unsupported, stripped, failed or inconclusive check continues normal detection; never infer originality.
A visible label, provider name, whitespace, unsigned metadata, copied header or generic public watermark presence cannot stop detection.
An external verifier requires a documented scope, authentic response, exact input binding, distinguishable failure states, real positive/negative fixtures and data controls before admission.
A qualified AI-involvement declaration does not locate every edit or prove complete authorship, truth, intent or court admissibility.
Catalog records do not feed the gate, API evidence or confidence. Research provenance is separate from each uploaded file's provenance.

shared_metadata.containers: Bounded readers for supported PNG/JPEG/WebP XMP/text/EXIF, media metadata, PDF Info/XMP and OOXML custom properties; see structured-source-labels.md.
shared_metadata.authentication: Unsigned claims only. Reserved fields/provider codes are not treated as verified signatures or resolved identities.
